run_beaver_mul: run the beaver mul protocol to securely multiply two additively secret-shared tensors
run_beaver_matmul: run the beaver matmul protocol to securely matrix-multiply two secret-shared tensors
run_beaver_conv2d: run the beaver conv2d protocol to securely compute 2D convolution on secret-shared tensors
run_beaver_square: run the beaver square protocol to securely compute the square of a secret-shared tensor
run_beaver_AND: run the beaver AND protocol to securely compute bitwise AND on two binary secret-shared tensors
